node.label: Sclerosing cholangitis
node.definition: Cholangitis associated with evident ductal fibrosis that develops as a consequence of long-standing bile duct inflammatory, obstruction, or ischemic injury; it can be obliterative or nonobliterative.

evidence.snippet: Cholestasis, progressive familial intrahepatic, 8: Sclerosing cholangitis (frequency 1/4) [PCS]
